description: Configuration for the CDF writer (CdfWriterConfig), placed at the root of the extractor config as `cdf-writer`. When present, the extractor registers its tasks, emitted views, mappings and bindings with the CDF writer at startup, and writes go through the CDF writer instead of directly to CDF.

merge.description: Integration-wide upsert merge behaviour. `replace` writes properties as emitted, without reading. `preserve` reads existing nodes first: object properties keep existing keys with emitted keys winning, lists union, scalars are replaced. Under `preserve`, objects never lose keys and lists never shrink.

mappings.description: Mapping definitions. `external-id` must be unique. A mapping that no binding refers to is allowed and ignored.

bindings.description: Bindings attaching integration tasks to mappings. Every (task, resource) pair the extractor declares must be covered by exactly one binding.

task-ids.description: Integration task names, verbatim. No wildcards.

mapping-id.description: `external-id` of a mapping in `mappings`. The binding covers every resource the mapping declares.

external-id.description: Identifier of the mapping, scoped to the integration.

api-version.description: CDF API version to write with. `beta` is required for state time series and `CogniteStateSet`.

resources.description: Emitted resource to its config block. A mapping declaring `CogniteTimeseries` should also declare the resources its direct relations target, such as `CogniteSourceSystem`.

properties.description: Optional Kuiper expression applied to upsert items, with the emitted item bound as `input`. Returns `{ type?, properties }`, or `null` to skip the item. An explicit `null` property clears it in CDF, so omit keys that should be left untouched.

auto-create-direct-relations.description: Create missing target nodes of direct relations.

property.description: Path to the value the rules match, as segments joined with dots. `[externalId]` matches the item's external ID on every operation. Any other path, such as `[extractedData, site]`, is read from upsert properties, and the chosen space is recorded for data points and deletes. Required together with `rules`.

rules.description: Tried in order, the first match wins. Patterns must be unique. Required together with `property`.

pattern.description: Regex matched against the whole value.

default.description: Space used when no rule matches, or when there are no rules.
